inference.confidence: high for this bounded synthetic I13 experiment
inference.basis: Actual Moxi work counters and SVG frames, five backend tests, normal-entry browser tests and unmodified browser captures.
inference.would_change: A failure replaying these fixtures through the normal entry point, source/binary mismatch, or divergent frame/state in a supported replay would change the conclusion.

limits: Synthetic captured I15 input only; no sensor, generator, async worker, account, production system or external service was rerun.
Async completion time/order was not captured by I15. The stored peak is applied after retained samples with time explicitly unknown.
Broad mode explicitly rebuilds the unrelated sibling; this is policy comparison, not App root fallback, arbitrary changed-code replay or hot reload.
Single-run monotonic dispatch and capture timings are diagnostics. No stable overhead, throughput, memory/allocation or latency benchmark is claimed.
Source eviction, absent retained observations, missing result and trace buffer eviction are independent; unavailable history cannot be reconstructed.
Native OS file-picker interaction was attempted but the automation did not open a picker. File-input upload of the on-disk saved fixture after reload passed; OS picker is unverified.
No VoiceOver by instruction; other browser/OS combinations, full repository tests, native-window Moxi rendering, physical instruments and production workloads were not tested.
The pixi task alias was inspected; the equivalent normal app.py entry was executed in an already installed repository environment. A new-environment pixi installation was not tested.
Screenshots establish appearance; the browser assertions and backend tests establish the specific behaviors. Capture timing text is intentionally variable.
No shared ledger/index, external write, push or further delegation occurred.
A complete browser console/network trace was not retained; expected400/413 responses and malformed-file recovery were asserted directly and are recorded here.
